items.text:
Ok, so there’s an ambitious sandbox game hiding here, with a full solar system to explore tucked behind a scroll-wheel zoom level. Seems like you can grow from a poor shipbreaker into a fleet owner and planetary resident.

I can’t say how much of that is actually implemented, because I’m still at the starter shipbreaking location. But...

From the early gameplay, it feels like the dev just gave up on finishing this game. The current systems are still pretty much placeholders or outright broken.

Especially the task system, which is just plain ♥♥♥♥-code (I’m sorry, but there’s no nicer way to put it). Most of the shipbreaking and shipbuilding currently plays like an idler at 16x speed, with periodic pauses to babysit the characters. Babysitting is required because the AI priority system is braindead and gets stuck in loops. Characters can’t grab stuff, drop stuff, or put stuff into things. Instead, they just walk between locations, endlessly failing tasks until you notice and sort out their inventory or pathfinding.

Hauling stuff is silly too. There’s no planning ahead, so characters carry only one item at a time. But fine, I can live with that. What I can’t live with is when it breaks in a way I can’t manually fix. My current save just went in the trash because I can’t recharge tools anymore. In autotask mode, the character now gets stuck trying and failing to insert a battery into an empty charger. I think the game considers the slots occupied, so the character just drops the battery on the floor.

But ok, playing an idler at 16x isn’t fun, right? Why not control the player manually and play a sim? Oh, because then you can only do one thing at a time. The task system doesn’t work at all with manual actions. You can’t queue up two walls for deconstruction; you have to wait for each action to finish before starting the next. Still at 16x speed, btw, because otherwise a repair can take 10 minutes of real time.

I know it’s supposed to be a masochistic space engineering sim, but all in all, it’s just a bad game. The dev just doesn’t know how to code.

Cool idea though.
items.text_zh:
好吧，所以这里隐藏着一个雄心勃勃的沙盒游戏，有一个完整的太阳系可以探索，藏在滚轮缩放级别后面。看起来你可以从一个贫穷的拆船工成长为舰队所有者和行星居民。

我无法说这些有多少是真正实现了的，因为我还待在起始的拆船地点。但是……

从早期的游戏体验来看，感觉开发者只是放弃完成这个游戏了。当前的系统基本上还是占位符或者干脆就是坏的。

尤其是任务系统，简直就是纯粹的♥♥♥♥代码（抱歉，但没有更委婉的说法了）。目前大部分的拆船和造船玩起来就像是一个16倍速的放置游戏，时不时要暂停来照看角色。需要照看是因为AI优先级系统蠢得要命，会卡在循环里。角色不能抓东西、丢东西，或者把东西放进东西里。相反，他们只是在地点之间走来走去，无休止地失败任务，直到你注意到并整理他们的物品栏或寻路。

搬运东西也很蠢。没有提前规划，所以角色一次只携带一件物品。但好吧，这个我能忍。我不能忍的是它以我无法手动修复的方式坏掉。我当前的存档刚刚进了垃圾桶，因为我再也不能给工具充电了。在自动任务模式下，角色现在会卡住，试图把电池插入一个空的充电器但一直失败。我觉得游戏认为插槽已被占用，所以角色就把电池丢在地上了。

但是好吧，以16倍速玩放置游戏不好玩，对吧？为什么不手动控制玩家来玩模拟呢？哦，因为那样你一次只能做一件事。任务系统在手动操作下完全不起作用。你不能排队拆除两堵墙；你必须等每个动作完成才能开始下一个。顺便说一下，还是16倍速，因为否则一次修理可能要花10分钟现实时间。

我知道这应该是一个受虐狂式的太空工程模拟，但总而言之，它就是一个糟糕的游戏。开发者就是不知道怎么编程。

不过想法很酷。

Мне дорога моя девушка и работа важна, поэтому ради этой игры пришлось пожертвовать сном и начать спать по 4 часа в среднем.

По геймплею - то ли баротравма, то ли проект зомбоид в космосе с генами Hardspace:Shipbreaker.

Я абсолютно понимаю негативные комментарии об игре из-за которых сомневался в покупке.
Да, она несколько багованная (хотя критических я не встречал, разве что однажды случайно умер и обнаружил, что автосохранение не работало последние 3 часа)
Да, я даже не зная ничего об игре до выхода "в релиз" вижу, что авторы задумывали раз в 10 больше контента, но споткнулись об амбиции. Ну моды прикрутили и то хорошо, фанаты допилят.
Да, оптимизация местами хромает (справедливости ради играю и на калькуляторе на работе нередко и на домашнем компе, оптимизация тут не зависит от железа, длительнейшие сохранения, фризы и падения ФПС вы испытаете в любом случае)
Да, ИИ тупейший. Показательный пример: боты на станции заметили пожар и побежали его тушить. Снаружи. Даже те, у кого были скафандры - шлемы не надели. Налутал я с них знатно. Захватил пирата с баунти за голову, запер в комнате с запасом еды и воды - он всё пытался выйти наружу воспользоваться кофейным автоматом, делая по тысяче просчётов маршрута в секунду, и из-за этого у меня ФПС падал до 1-10 кадров в секунду. И подобное происходит регулярно.
Да менеджмент инвентаря обычно ад из матрёшки. 
Да, редактор персонажа странный. Предполагается, что твой персонаж будет либо рандомным, но, потенциально, сильнее. Либо такой какой ты сам соберёшь. Но через пару созданий персонажа ты понимаешь как абузить систему и сесть на два стула.
Ну и да, порог вхождения немаленький. Даже несмотря на обучение и гайды (в том числе внутриигровые)


Но господи, как же я кайфанул несмотря на это. Пилишь себе кораблики в космосе. Или восстанавливаешь. Обустраиваешь своё корыто или копишь на новое. Обычный такой космический работяга. Где-то там вокруг крутится огромный мир, который только предстоит исследовать. Накопить денег, стать дальнобоем и купить там квартиру после первого рейса? А может стать шахтёром на астероидах, говорят такая возможность тоже где-то есть? А может стать баунти-хантером? Курьером? Или спиться водкой ночуя в спальном мешке в куче окурков на флотилии? И даже для этого тебе придётся реально включить голову чтобы понять, как это всё работает! Чувствуется какой-то интерес. Жизнь, движуха.

我的女朋友对我很重要，工作也很重要，所以为了这款游戏，我不得不牺牲睡眠，开始平均每天只睡4个小时。

就玩法而言——这要么是气压创伤，要么是太空中的僵尸项目，带着《Hardspace:Shipbreaker》的基因。

我完全理解那些关于这款游戏的负面评论，正因为它们我才对购买犹豫不决。
是的，它有些bug（虽然我没遇到过什么严重的，除非有一次我意外死了，然后发现自动存档在过去3个小时里根本没工作）
是的，即使我在“正式发布”之前对这款游戏一无所知，我也能看出作者原本设想的內容要多出10倍，但被野心绊倒了。不过好歹把mod接上了，这也不错，粉丝们会把它补完的。
是的，优化在某些地方很糟糕（公平地说，我经常在工作的计算器上玩，也在家里的电脑上玩，这里的优化不取决于硬件，超长的保存时间、卡顿和帧数下降你无论如何都会遇到）
是的，AI蠢到极点。一个典型的例子：空间站上的机器人发现了火灾，然后跑去灭火。从外面。即使是那些有宇航服的——也没戴上头盔。我从它们身上搜刮了不少好东西。我抓了一个有悬赏的赏金海盗，把他锁在一个有食物和水的房间里——他一直试图出去用咖啡机，每秒进行上千次路径计算，因此我的帧数掉到了每秒1-10帧。类似的事情经常发生。
是的，物品栏管理通常是套娃式的地狱。
是的，角色编辑器很奇怪。按理说你的角色要么是随机的，但可能更强。要么就是你自己捏出来的那个。但创建过几个角色之后，你就明白怎么滥用这个系统，然后两头占便宜了。
嗯，是的，入门门槛不低。即使有教程和攻略（包括游戏内的）也一样


但是天哪，尽管如此我还是玩得太爽了。在太空里给自己造小船。或者修复。布置自己的破船，或者攒钱买新的。就是个普通的太空打工人。周围某个地方转动着一个巨大的世界，等着你去探索。攒钱，成为长途货运司机，然后跑完第一趟就在那儿买套公寓？或者成为小行星矿工，据说这种机会也在某个地方存在？或者成为赏金猎人？快递员？还是在舰队里睡在睡袋里、躺在一堆烟头中喝伏特加喝到烂醉？甚至为了做到这些，你都得真正动脑子去搞明白这一切是怎么运作的！能感觉到某种趣味。生活，活力。

I took a week off to renovate the house. Let's just say I didn't get much renovating done. The game is addictive and feels huge. I've played 50 hours and have only just started venturing out from the starting area. 
I like the RPG-style character creation and the large debt you have to pay off gives you a clear goal. Since ships are so expensive, it makes more sense to upgrade the one you start with. That also helps you learn the basics of shipbuilding while salvaging and tearing down other ships. 

I'd like an easier way to track quests that aren't on the current map, more dialogue options, and a better tutorial. Some in-game videos explaining the mechanics would be helpful. 

I did encounter one bug where the game would crash if I tried to load a save while already playing, but they fixed that and I haven't had any other bugs since.

items.text:
Edit: added parts about social and modding.

Full of bugs, poor design around every corner, and questionable balance. Also very unique, with absolutely no alternative.

Would I play it more? Absolutely. Would I enjoy it? Probably not. That's the nature of a toxic relationship.

Now, a little bit more in depth:

[h1]Bugs.[/h1]

There are a lot. Honestly, at some point I'm not entirely sure what is a bug and what is bad design. FPS drops, script errors, physics, memory leaks, everything would be broken at some point. I liked it a lot one time when the game created all files for a save, but didn't put them into a zip archive and couldn't read this save file. Easy fix, though.

[h1]Poor design[/h1]

Well, the list would be as long as the game features. Basically, everything that you would do in this game would be made in the most stupid, time-consuming, unfun way. I'm pretty sure that AI slop would make a better design. Here is a little list of examples:

When you load the game, the splash screen with update info is right before loading. I think it doesn't block the loading itself, it's just its placement is very inconvenient.

* UI is just plain bad. All of it. Like, when you're in a helmet, it blocks your UI. Because of this, I missed a very important button for 30 hours. All bags are just a fit of tedious micromanagement. Character traits are just a long list of perks without much formatting. Visor in damage mode doesn't let you see building marks, and it's VERY NEEDED to see them in that mode. When you dock, "Match speed" and "Prox Warn" alarms are not in the dock screen, AND YOU REALLY NEED THEM IN THE DOCK SCREEN.

* Quests are just 98% plain text, without barely any choices, no scene art, not even book formatting.
AI. It's very long to describe how poor the AI in this game is, it's easy to find info on all problems with it. Let's just say they often choose death instead of being part of this game. But without jokes, many people decide to play without crew at all and not deal with AI. I guess that says a lot.

* Close-quarters combat is rudimentary. Well, it's just not fun at its core and stupid. Why the hell do people with lethal wounds in vacuum die after like 5 minutes?

* Ship building. It mostly works. But there is absolutely no dry dock in the game, so you need to do it in vacuum, and that means you need to deal with AI and micromanage them, because they can randomly stop changing batteries or O2 tanks and just die. It's also a HUGE TIME SINK. At least 15 of my playtime hours were spent waiting for things to be done.

[h1]Loot[/h1]

It's sad to say, but you will see 80-90% of loot in the first 4 hours in the starter playground. There is just barely any WOW effect, not many things to be discovered. No gold mine to strike. It's just a tedious, steady grind. This problem is tied to general economy balance. In a game about making coin by salvage and exploration, this was a HUGE LETDOWN.

[H1]Social combat/NPC dialogues [/H1]

You know, I like it on paper. I think I even grasp what you need to do for results. But there is no real explanation of the system in the game or on the internet. But in reality, it's a mesh of bad UI and poor action feedback to the player. First, why do you need to look at 3-4 different parts of the screen to see the outcome of your actions after every click? Second, why do stats jump like mad when you click on an option with a simple outcome? NPCs 80% of the time answer gibberish because they play the same system, and you also say a lot of gibberish. There's really good gameplay here, but it's buried under layers of undercooked implementations.


[h1]Balance[/h1]

Well, it's shaky at best. Economy is weird and very artificial. As I said, it's a problem tied to loot. Without interesting, varied loot, it's hard to balance the economy. So they made GIGS. So you don't need to look for 10-20k ships, you can take a gig that will pay you 30k for a VERY easy task at the ship, and you can also loot this ship. But gig payments crumble under their own weight, because they're balanced around distance. So you have delivery gigs that pay you 1500, and the same delivery gigs that pay you 10mil. So, why would I salvage anything in this game about salvaging things, when I can just travel from A to B and make 2000% more profit?

Little bit about combat balance. Imagine, you're a skilled space suit user. You're in vacuum. You have a crowbar. You feel brave and on top of your game. You have no combat experience. And your enemy is a poor space suit user. He has insomnia and is on the edge of a breakdown. He's terrified. He has a pocket knife. He's 1 level higher than you in combat. Who would win? Of course, the enemy. He will absolutely destroy you with his bare hands; he wouldn't even use the pocket knife. I guess that's fair.

[h1]Mods[/h1]
Modding community is strong for a generally low playerbase. But they mostly fix annoying and bad design and UI, but they can't fix everything. This is a job for the developer. There really shouldn't be a mod that mutes the proximity alarm when you're docked, or a mod that adds EVA suit lockers, or a mod that lets AI grab multiple items before starting to work with said items. This all should be part of the base game like yesterday.

--------

So no, I can't recommend this game to anyone. Developers shouldn't release games in such a poor state out of desperation. But yes, I would probably play it more, because this is a way of a toxic relationship.
items.text_zh:
编辑：添加了关于社交和模组的部分。

到处都是bug，每个角落的设计都很糟糕，平衡性也值得怀疑。同时它又非常独特，完全没有替代品。

我会玩得更多吗？绝对会。我会享受它吗？大概不会。这就是有毒关系的本质。

现在，再深入一点：

[h1]Bug。[/h1]

有很多。老实说，到了某个时候，我都不完全确定什么是bug，什么是糟糕的设计。帧率下降、脚本错误、物理、内存泄漏，一切都会在某个时候出问题。有一次我特别喜欢的是，游戏为一个存档创建了所有文件，但没有把它们放进zip压缩包，然后无法读取这个存档文件。不过修复很简单。

[h1]糟糕的设计[/h1]

嗯，这个清单会和游戏功能一样长。基本上，你在这个游戏里做的每件事都会以最愚蠢、最耗时、最不好玩的方式来完成。我很确定AI生成的垃圾都能做出更好的设计。这里有一个小例子清单：

当你加载游戏时，带有更新信息的启动画面就在加载之前。我觉得它不会阻止加载本身，只是它的位置非常不方便。

* UI就是纯粹的糟糕。全部都是。比如，当你戴着头盔时，它会挡住你的UI。因为这个，我错过了30个小时里一个非常重要的按钮。所有背包都只是一堆繁琐的微观管理。角色特质只是一长串没有多少格式的perk。伤害模式下的面罩不让你看到建筑标记，而在那个模式下看到它们是非常必要的。当你停靠时，“匹配速度”和“接近警告”警报不在停靠界面里，而你在停靠界面里真的非常需要它们。

* 任务98%都是纯文本，几乎没有选择，没有场景美术，甚至没有书籍排版。
AI。描述这个游戏里的AI有多糟糕需要很长时间，很容易找到关于它所有问题的信息。我们就说他们经常选择死亡，而不是成为这个游戏的一部分。但不开玩笑地说，很多人决定完全不带船员玩，不跟AI打交道。我想这说明了很多。

* 近身战斗很简陋。嗯，它的核心就是不好玩而且愚蠢。为什么在真空中受了致命伤的人会在大概5分钟后死掉？

* 飞船建造。它基本上能用。但游戏里绝对没有干船坞，所以你需要在真空中进行，这意味着你需要处理AI并微观管理他们，因为他们会随机停止更换电池或氧气罐，然后直接死掉。这也是一个巨大的时间黑洞。我至少有15个小时的游戏时间花在等待事情完成上。

[h1]战利品[/h1]

说起来很遗憾，但你会在新手游乐场的前4个小时里看到80-90%的战利品。几乎没有什么WOW效果，没有多少东西可供发现。没有金矿可挖。这只是一个乏味、稳定的刷。这个问题与总体经济平衡有关。在一个通过打捞和探索赚钱的游戏中，这是一个巨大的失望。

[H1]社交战斗/NPC对话 [/H1]

你知道，理论上我喜欢它。我想我甚至明白你需要做什么才能得到结果。但游戏里或网上都没有对这个系统的真正解释。但实际上，它是糟糕UI和对玩家行动反馈不佳的混合体。首先，为什么你每次点击后都需要看屏幕上3-4个不同的部分才能看到你行动的结果？其次，为什么当你点击一个结果简单的选项时，属性会疯狂跳动？NPC有80%的时间回答的是胡言乱语，因为他们玩的是同一个系统，你也会说很多胡言乱语。这里确实有很好的玩法，但它被层层未煮熟的实现埋没了。


[h1]平衡[/h1]

嗯，往好了说也是摇摇欲坠。经济很奇怪而且非常人为。正如我所说，这是一个与战利品相关的问题。没有有趣、多样的战利品，就很难平衡经济。所以他们做了GIGS。这样你就不需要寻找1-2万的飞船，你可以接一个GIG，在飞船上做一个非常简单的任务就能付你3万，而且你还可以打捞这艘飞船。但GIG的报酬在自身重量下崩溃了，因为它们是围绕距离来平衡的。所以你有付你1500的送货GIG，也有付你1000万的同样的送货GIG。那么，在这个关于打捞东西的游戏中，我为什么要打捞任何东西，当我可以从A旅行到B并赚取多2000%的利润时？

关于战斗平衡说一点。想象一下，你是一个熟练的太空服使用者。你在真空中。你有一根撬棍。你感到勇敢，状态极佳。你没有战斗经验。而你的敌人是一个可怜的太空服使用者。他失眠，处于崩溃边缘。他吓坏了。他有一把袖珍刀。他在战斗中比你高1级。谁会赢？当然是敌人。他会赤手空拳绝对摧毁你；他甚至不会用袖珍刀。我想这很公平。

[h1]模组[/h1]
对于一个总体玩家基数很低的游戏来说，模组社区很强大。但他们大多修复烦人和糟糕的设计与UI，但他们不能修复一切。这是开发者的工作。真的不应该有一个模组来在你停靠时静音接近警报，或者一个模组来添加EVA服储物柜，或者一个模组让AI在开始处理物品之前抓取多个物品。所有这些昨天就应该成为基础游戏的一部分。

--------

所以不，我不能向任何人推荐这个游戏。开发者不应该出于绝望而发布处于如此糟糕状态的游戏。但是的，我可能会玩得更多，因为这是一种有毒关系的方式。

1.0, but still incredibly buggy. Give it a bit.

Pretty decent storylines, or at-least what they're consisting of so far is pretty good. The game, even after 'full release' is basically Bethesda-coded, with bugs that range from minor annoyances to "I had to restart my 60 hour save because of this ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ bug." And some of the worst combat I've seen in a game like this. 

Ideas to make the game less of a misery:
-Fix the horrible bug that disables your ability to actually construct anything, despite having the tools and items to do so
-Get rid of the annoying loading splash screen (Why do we gotta' click? Just load.)
-Fix the god-awful lag/stuttering/freezing issues
-Fix the scroll-wheel's zoom rubber banding after exiting a menu.
-Fix the horrible PDA files ui
-Fix the strangely low spawn rate for Heavy Water containers.
-Make it obvious which PDA is yours in the files menu
-Make it impossible for police to warrant you when a ship's transponder is off.
-O2 tank refill auto-shutoff
-Player-placed items REMAIN the player's property. (That's my battery charger, stop arresting me because I picked it up.)
-Allow docking at stations while towing a vessel
-Make most containers on-board ships and station private property so I can't just yoink someone's weed cigs.
-Different ways of reaching other planets without having to grind for RL days to get a Torch Drive.
-More space horror
-Add the transit kiosks in a tram-like station so we aren't just teleporting to other parts of stations.
-More advancements from certain NEOScavenger plots.
- Less tedious sleep/super-fast skip mechanic
- Refined auto-task coding (No, I don't want you to stand there with an empty power drill, PUT your fully charged back-up battery in it!)

Во-первых: игра не даст вам создать именно такого персонажа, какого вы хотите. В окне настройки перса есть кнопка "выбрать навыки" - но там навыки прибавляют много возраста персу, к тому же там даже не все навыки представлены. Тут нас обязывают начинать либо молодым но нищим и ничего не умеющим, либо стариком с каким-никаким капиталом и набором умений но с кучей травм и врагов/друзей с которыми еще придется разбираться.
items.text_zh:
首先：游戏不会让你创建出你真正想要的那种角色。在角色设置窗口里有一个“选择技能”按钮——但那里的技能会给角色增加很多年龄，而且那里甚至没有列出所有技能。还有一个类似“生活和积累经验”的按钮——给年龄加 1 岁，但可能立刻给你好几个技能。还有创伤。而你可能进监狱，花掉大约 5 年人生。或者甚至在游戏开始前就得到一堆朋友/敌人。而这一切纯粹都是随机的。在其中一个事件里有几率赢得一艘飞船。如果你赢了——接下来的角色创建就会立刻被锁定，就这样，既然有飞船——你就必须开始游戏。
   其次：操作非常不方便。界面极其不友好。刚开始你甚至没法查看角色的属性。
   第三：bug。有些可能会毁掉你的存档。

在我看来，这类游戏的主要问题在于，开发者试图强迫玩家按照他想要的方式去玩，而不是按照玩家想要的方式。在这里，我们被迫要么以年轻但一贫如洗、什么都不会的状态开始，要么以带着那么点资本和一套技能、但有一堆创伤以及还得去应付的朋友/敌人的老人状态开始。

items.text_zh:
这游戏到底凭什么算正式发布了？

我整个游戏时间的前200小时左右，都花在等待卡顿、猜测这是不是bug，以及像个疯子一样对着显示器尖叫上。
这游戏甚至没有好的内容或AI系统。没有职业选择，没有社交系统，犯罪没有真正的后果，战斗也太简单了。而且游戏里大多数技能甚至都还没实装，所以角色创建时根本没有理由去选它们。每一局新游戏都一样，实际上，你之所以要开新档，唯一原因就是开发者无能，他们每周都在更新游戏，结果给存档文件带来更多问题，还让mod社区疲惫不堪。

游戏宣传说雇佣船员和使用枪械是件有趣的事。听起来很棒吧？你可以拥有自己的私人军队、海盗船或雇佣兵。而且还有具备枪械技能的NPC，你实际上也可以以枪械技能开局。
然而，这些枪械技能甚至都没在游戏里实装。而且它们在游戏过程中也无法获得。很奇怪吧？如果你开枪开得足够多，总该在某个时候能打中点什么吧。但玩家即使有枪械技能也还是会打到自己。此外，大多数海盗都带着空的手枪，NPC也不携带步枪，尽管枪械真的很便宜，而且空间站里还成批出售。

我直接问过开发者，你们为什么不修复这些枪械技能问题？他说，战斗不是我们的优先事项。哈？所以他们是在承认，他们只是虚假宣传了游戏的核心机制之一？

而且即使在正式发布之后，船员仍有AI问题，他们就是不能正常工作。所以大多数玩家干脆谁也不雇，在没有这个功能的情况下玩游戏。所以我会把这游戏称为一坨烂货和一场骗局。考虑到这游戏已经开发了大概，我也不知道，十年？而且游戏里大多数空间站甚至都没有和其他空间站连接起来，尽管它们有地铁？

内容匮乏、虚假宣传、玩法重复，简直就是对游戏社区的侮辱，居然还正式发布了这游戏

I can’t stop thinking about this while I’m not playing it.

Just need to salvage one more ship, it might be a big one…

Это странная игра. Что-то вроде внебрачного дитя barotrauma, kerbal space program, sims и Neo scavenger. В основе своей это RPG, вы играете за эдакого космического бича, который, получив где-то какой-то жизненный опыт (экран создания персонажа), обзавелся своим совершенно ушатанным ржавым космическим кораблём и теперь шарится по каким-то свалкам кораблей и помойкам ради оплаты ипотеки на этот самый корабль, венерианского гражданства и однушки на станции K-Leg. 

Вроде задел колоссальный, механик масса, а вроде играется как технодемка. Огромное количество багов и адски тупой ии, который убивает себя сам за считанные минуты. Часть багов смешные, часть совершенно ломающие, часть потенциально могут уничтожить ваш сейв. Большая часть того что вы можете и не можете делать так или иначе упирается в слабый ии. Более того игра постоянно подталкивает вас к кретинистическому взаимодействию с местными болванчиками. Возможно, просто мой персонаж такой стрёмный, но у меня не получается нормально взаимодействовать с местными нормисами и они все почему-то отказываются работать на моей ласточке.
items.text_zh:
这是一款奇怪的游戏。有点像barotrauma、kerbal space program、sims和Neo scavenger的私生子。本质上它是一款RPG，你扮演一个太空流浪汉，在某个地方获得了一些人生经验（角色创建界面），搞到了一艘彻底破烂生锈的宇宙飞船，现在为了偿还这艘船的房贷、维纳斯公民身份和K-Leg空间站上的一居室，在某个飞船垃圾场和垃圾堆里翻找。

看起来底子很宏大，机制一大堆，但玩起来却像技术演示。大量的bug和蠢到极点的AI，几分钟内就能把自己弄死。有些bug很搞笑，有些彻底破坏游戏，有些甚至可能毁掉你的存档。你能做和不能做的大部分事情，或多或少都受限于弱智的AI。此外，游戏不断推动你与当地那些蠢货进行白痴般的互动。也许只是我的角色太糟糕了，但我就是没法正常与当地那些普通人互动，而且他们不知为何都拒绝在我的小燕子号上工作。

items.text:
I love this game to death, I love its concept, I love the mechanics, I love how each update added a lot of brand new content to the game. I love the ship building, I love the writing, I love the lore, I love the music....

I can't recommed this game. The main reason is that it doesn't respect your time. This is a multi layered issue and I'll explain.

In its state that it has been for years (and will resume to be), the game just runs like complete and utter ♥♥♥♥ and the performance has only gotten far worse. The game is optimized for higher end rigs so if you got a mediocre laptop, you'll struggle to run it. I've lost countless hours combined from crashes and corrupt saves, that's another big flaw. The game will save but in the save folder, the save.info file will be missing so you think you saved the game, quit and you lost all your work. With the 0.15 update, the patch notes toted that they upgraded performance. That's bs, the game runs worse on a fresh save than it did before. More crashes as well, BUT, it does handle long running games better than it did before, I'll give them that. So the baseline performance of the game was hampered, the garbage control (RAM reallocation) improved so you no longer have to restart your game ideally every 2 hours (that's right, that used to be a thing, there were AND STILL ARE serious memory leak issues). Big ships will slow your game down heavily, and this promotes the same limiting mentality on creativity that dwarf fortress also possesses: You limit your projects to something smaller scale so the engine/your pc can run the game and it doesn't run on 2 FPS as your projects become more entropic.

There's a lot of other issues that fall under the curtain and get brushed aside because the game is still in early access, but just because a game is in early access, doesn't give it a forcefield from criticism that disallows it from getting any flak for the current state of implemented features. I say this because I want to address some core features of the game that are flawed on a fundamental level, that are broken but not because the game is in early access. That's the other thing. It's the assumption that a feature, mechanic, system in an early access game is going to get fixed or improved once 1.0 comes out or after. No, these cases are rare to begin with and it varies from feature to feature. The AI's piloting is ♥♥♥♥, has always been ♥♥♥♥ and will resume to be ♥♥♥♥, the AI on station is also just surface level implementation, though the social combat system looks really in-depth, it's incredibly shallow, as most social actions are boilerplate. There have been tweaks and modifications to AI behavior in patch notes and this is the state they are in after so much refinement. Not very encouraging.

The monthly update reports that I viewed ever since 0.13.x days have had many niche logic bugs that come from the inherent complex systems of the game (temperature, durability, inventory system, weight etc.). This makes it far harder and much slower to diagnose and address game breaking bugs. The team's progress is glacial, and a lot of their efforts are spent on trying to maintain the game in a playable state, which they are failing at.

If we removie all that negativity, you have the economy system which is the progression path of the game as you start from a junker ship and a mortgage. The economy is busted and imbalanced, money is completely trivial and it neither rewards the player for hard work, neither does it punish appropriately like when they break the law or pay fines for overdue payments. You can commit a murder and the cops will fine you 15.000 dollars which is a pitance. That mortgage is also getting paid off really fast, don't worry. 

Gameplay wise, the game as a sandbox is pretty empty. Still is in version 0.15 even after they added ship combat and asteroid mining. You have little to no insentive sadly because it's again unbalanced. AI just sits there and takes it while you shoot them, they can't battle with you properly because the piloting AI is so bad. Asteroid mining is subpar to trading wares OR the even more busted gig economy, which was broken even more with the addition of long range travel. You can now pickup a gig in Kleg, Venus or Ceres that's on another planet, have it pay a premium because it's a few astral units away from your location, take a ferry to said location instantly (yes INSTANTLY, they don't even bother simulating travel time with a ferry) and voila, you just made 4-9 million dollars with 0 effort.

So the game is unbalanced, runs like a corpse, the AI is braindead, so what else is there? The main thing? Shipbuilding. That's it. Shipbuilding. It does it really ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ well and it's super fun and relaxing to build your ship. It's a really cathartic process. You get to build your mini home in space and there's seriously indepth customization for it (waiting for them to add planters to the sundries kiosk). It's the main selling point of the game. It's just a shame that other features in the game aren't polished to even a fraction of a fraction that shipbuilding has. Also, sadly, shipbuilding takes a long time to do in general (stripping apart ships, putting them together, repairing them, etc.) and you can't realistically do this whilst also juggling a fulltime job, or have a life. Ostranauts is not for people who have limited time.

TL;DR: Ostranauts has a lot of amazing ideas and concepts but fails at executing them. It runs really bad (lots of crashes and corrupt saves, lots of memory leak within a short amount of time), its AI is really simplistic and has no depth to it, the combat is shamefully undercooked and easy, economy is completely unbalanced which doesn't challenge or reward the player, development is super slow and the updates don't address core fundamental issues... but hey, the shipbuilding is fun.

I hate it but I'll still play it and keep following the development closely. I already know realistically what the devs can and can't do with the shoestring budget they got and the time they have but still praying for a miracle cause I care about Ostranauts. I know the game's performance will forever be ♥♥♥♥, that the AI will forever be stupid and boring, that the economy will be broken and unbalanced, and that the combat will be busted and favor the player... but I still hold out some hope. As it is though, this game isn't for anyone who has a life
items.text_zh:
我爱这款游戏爱到死，我爱它的概念，我爱它的机制，我爱每次更新都为游戏添加大量全新内容。我爱造船，我爱它的文字，我爱它的背景设定，我爱它的音乐……

我不能推荐这款游戏。主要原因是它不尊重你的时间。这是一个多层次的问题，我会解释。

在它多年来一直处于（并将继续处于）的状态下，游戏运行起来就像一坨彻头彻尾的♥♥♥♥，而且性能只会越来越糟。游戏是为高端配置优化的，所以如果你只有一台平庸的笔记本电脑，你会很难运行它。我因为崩溃和存档损坏已经累计损失了无数小时，这是另一个大缺陷。游戏会保存，但在存档文件夹里，save.info文件会缺失，所以你以为自己保存了游戏，退出后就丢失了所有工作成果。随着0.15更新，补丁说明吹嘘他们升级了性能。那是胡说八道，游戏在新存档上运行得比以前更糟。崩溃也更多了，但是，它处理长时间运行的游戏确实比以前好了，这点我承认。所以游戏的基础性能被削弱了，垃圾控制（RAM重新分配）改善了，所以你不再需要理想情况下每2小时重启一次游戏（没错，这曾经是常态，曾经存在而且现在仍然存在严重的内存泄漏问题）。大型飞船会严重拖慢你的游戏，这助长了与《矮人要塞》相同的限制创造力的心态：你把项目限制在较小规模，这样引擎/你的电脑才能运行游戏，不至于随着你的项目变得更加混乱而让游戏以2 FPS运行。

还有很多其他问题被掩盖在帷幕之下，被搁置一旁，因为游戏仍处于抢先体验阶段，但仅仅因为一款游戏处于抢先体验阶段，并不意味着它有一层免受批评的力场，不允许它因当前已实现功能的状态而受到任何抨击。我这么说是因为我想指出游戏中一些在根本层面上就有缺陷的核心功能，它们是坏的，但并不是因为游戏处于抢先体验阶段。这是另一回事。那就是一种假设，认为抢先体验游戏中的某个功能、机制、系统会在1.0发布时或之后得到修复或改进。不，这些情况本来就很少见，而且因功能而异。AI的驾驶技术是♥♥♥♥，一直都是♥♥♥♥，并将继续是♥♥♥♥，空间站上的AI也只是表面层次的实现，虽然社交战斗系统看起来非常深入，但它极其肤浅，因为大多数社交行动都是模板化的。补丁说明中对AI行为有过调整和修改，这就是经过如此多打磨后它们所处的状态。不太令人鼓舞。

自0.13.x时代以来我查看的每月更新报告中有许多小众逻辑错误，这些错误来自游戏固有的复杂系统（温度、耐久度、库存系统、重量等）。这使得诊断和解决破坏游戏的错误变得更加困难和缓慢。团队的进展如冰川般缓慢，他们的很多精力都花在试图维持游戏的可玩状态上，而他们在这方面正在失败。

如果我们去掉所有这些负面内容，你还有经济系统，它是游戏的进程路径，因为你从一艘破烂飞船和一笔抵押贷款开始。经济系统是崩坏的且不平衡的，金钱完全微不足道，它既不奖励玩家的辛勤工作，也不在玩家违法或为逾期付款缴纳罚款时进行适当的惩罚。你可以犯下谋杀罪，警察只会罚你15,000美元，这简直是杯水车薪。那笔抵押贷款也会很快还清，别担心。

从玩法上看，这款游戏作为沙盒相当空洞。即使在0.15版本中，即使他们添加了飞船战斗和小行星采矿，情况依然如此。遗憾的是，你几乎没有动力，因为它再次不平衡。AI只是坐在那里挨打，当你射击它们时，它们无法与你正常战斗，因为驾驶AI太差了。小行星采矿不如交易货物，也不如更加崩坏的零工经济，而后者随着长途旅行的加入变得更加崩坏。你现在可以在Kleg、Venus或Ceres接一个在另一个星球上的零工，因为它离你的位置有几个天文单位远而支付溢价，然后立即乘坐渡轮前往该地点（是的，立即，他们甚至懒得模拟渡轮的旅行时间），瞧，你刚刚以0努力赚了400万到900万美元。

所以游戏不平衡，运行得像一具尸体，AI是脑死亡的，那还有什么？主要的东西？造船。就是这样。造船。它做得非常♥♥♥♥♥♥♥好，建造你的飞船超级有趣且放松。这是一个非常宣泄的过程。你可以建造你在太空中的迷你家园，而且有非常深入的定制（等待他们在杂货亭添加花盆）。这是游戏的主要卖点。只是遗憾的是，游戏中的其他功能连造船功能的一小部分的一小部分都没有打磨到。而且，遗憾的是，造船总体上需要很长时间（拆解飞船、组装、修理等），你无法在兼顾全职工作或拥有生活的同时现实地做到这一点。Ostranauts不适合时间有限的人。

TL;DR：Ostranauts有很多惊人的想法和概念，但在执行上失败了。它运行得非常糟糕（大量崩溃和存档损坏，短时间内大量内存泄漏），它的AI非常简陋且没有深度，战斗可耻地欠火候且简单，经济完全不平衡，既不挑战也不奖励玩家，开发超级缓慢，更新没有解决核心根本问题……但是嘿，造船很有趣。

我讨厌它，但我仍然会玩它并密切关注开发进展。我已经现实地知道开发者用他们那点微薄预算和有限时间能做什么和不能做什么，但仍然祈祷奇迹，因为我在乎Ostranauts。我知道游戏的性能将永远是♥♥♥♥，AI将永远愚蠢无聊，经济将永远崩坏不平衡，战斗将永远崩坏且偏向玩家……但我仍然抱有一些希望。不过就目前而言，这款游戏不适合任何有生活的人
它也不会像当人们违法或为逾期付款缴纳罚款时那样给予适当的惩罚。你可以犯下谋杀罪，而警察只会罚你15,000美元，这简直是微不足道。那笔抵押贷款也会很快还清，别担心。

从玩法上讲，这个游戏作为一个沙盒是相当空洞的。即使在他们加入了飞船战斗和小行星采矿之后，它仍然停留在0.15版本。可悲的是，你几乎没有或完全没有动力，因为它再次失衡了。AI只是坐在那里挨打，当你射击它们时，它们无法与你正常战斗，因为驾驶AI太糟糕了。小行星采矿不如交易货物，也不如那更加崩坏的零工经济，而后者随着长途旅行的加入变得更加崩坏。你现在可以在Kleg、Venus或Ceres接一个在另一个星球上的零工，因为它离你的位置有几个天文单位而支付溢价，然后瞬间乘坐渡船到那个地点（是的，瞬间，他们甚至懒得模拟渡船的旅行时间），瞧，你刚刚以0努力赚了400万到900万美元。

所以游戏失衡，运行得像一具尸体，AI脑死亡，那还有什么？主要的东西？造船。就是这样。造船。它做得真的♥♥♥♥♥♥♥好，而且建造你的飞船超级有趣和放松。这是一个非常宣泄的过程。你可以建造你在太空中的迷你家园，而且有非常深入的定制（等着他们在杂货亭加入花盆）。这是游戏的主要卖点。只是遗憾的是，游戏中的其他功能连造船所拥有的哪怕一丝一毫的打磨都没有。而且，可悲的是，造船总体上需要很长时间（拆解飞船、组装它们、修理它们等等），你无法在兼顾全职工作或拥有生活的同时现实地做到这一点。Ostranauts不适合时间有限的人。

TL;DR：Ostranauts有很多惊人的想法和概念，但在执行上失败了。它运行得非常糟糕（大量崩溃和存档损坏，短时间内大量内存泄漏），它的AI非常简陋且没有深度，战斗可耻地欠火候且简单，经济完全失衡，既不挑战也不奖励玩家，开发超级缓慢，更新没有解决核心根本问题……但是嘿，造船很有趣。

我讨厌它，但我仍然会玩它并密切关注开发。我已经现实地知道开发者用他们那点微薄预算和有限时间能做什么和不能做什么，但仍然祈祷奇迹，因为我在乎Ostranauts。我知道游戏的性能将永远♥♥♥♥，AI将永远愚蠢和无聊，经济将永远崩坏和失衡，战斗将永远破烂并偏向玩家……但我仍然抱有一些希望。不过就目前而言，这个游戏不适合任何有生活的人

老实说，我希望我还能说我认可这款游戏。但如果这就是他们的目标的话。我不知道。


我希望他们能修好它。

I love the game to bits, but recently I've come to a difficult conclusion: I actually can't recommend the game right now. Entirely because I can't actually PLAY the game for long. 
All my recent playthroughs have met their ends to frustration. I can't leave the same boneyard that was there years ago, either due to bugs or crashes. The game has major memory issues, crashing itself and steam after a few hours each time at first, but gets up to multiple times an hour the longer things go on. I started the game up to give the 1.0 a try and It's been 4 hours. This is my second crash, and one that in addition to crashing steam as it often does, I can't load the last two autosaves.
In previous recent playthroughs I managed to leave the boneyard only by transit service. In that game I mined half an asteroid with a ship I bought, crashed, mined another quarter, crashed and I gave up.
As I said, love the game to bits. But I cannot recommend it, knowing how frustrating it is to TRY playing it

items.text:
[h2] The core game is solid, however due to optimazation, and lack of proper guidance in-game (was watching hours of guides of what little good ones there was on youtube), and frankly how ugly all the characters are is annoying as hell, pretty hard to even customize a good looking character. Like come on, this is a fictional reality you want people to lose themselves in right? [/h2]

[h3] Pros [/h3]
[list]
[*] Fully customizable ship
[*] - You can move things around like the pilot seat etc. without worry too much 

[*] Solid building system once you understand it

[*] Very free sandbox
[*] - You can travel to many places have many npc interactions

[*] You feel your progress
[*] - Going from a death trap 10x10 to expanding your ship to 50x50 feels really good as you can salvage a lot more and build wealth incredibly fast

[*] Rather addicting gameplay loop
[*] - Until you stablize your financials in game then performance becomes an issue

[*] Character protraits being animated is nice, as they show real time conditions of the characters
[/list]

[h3] Cons [/h3]
[*] Quite a bit of bugs, some even tied to save files so a full restart doesn't fix it 
[*] - Had a cough perpetually cause I was exposed to some people smoking and have had it for 8 hrs of gameplay till the character died and I started a new game

[*] Pretty big optimization issues as you scale up
[*] - Had managed to hire 1 more crew member and it was kind of chugging

[*] The whole job system seemed so tedious compared to salavaging I don't really see the point
[*] - Should have some simpler ones like repair things around the station as well. As I imagine you would want to do those jobs for when you are struggling financially

[*] Character protraits generally are very aesthetically hard to look at for seemingly no good reason, even the rich which would likely have access to cosmetic sugergy etc.

[*] Some skills like hacking seemingly have no easy way to be acquired outside of during character creation
[*] - This really limits what you can go for it feels without kneecapping your early game

[*] Super cluttery UI that does not remember their window positions so you have to rearrange it any time you open and close
[*]  - Might benefit from being able to snap to place to a grid or each other

[*] Pretty janky AI, ranges from police ships deathballing into your own, AI crew members getting themselves killed and carrying things one by one rather than using a cart.
[/list] 

[h2] In conclusion [/h2]
If we were to take out all the optimization issues and you do not mind watching a lot of guides. The game would probably land on around a 6.5/10 if it were not for how hard it is to look at most of the characters. 

I can see the core early game is enticing if you got a good early setup via character creation career. It would definitely benefit from keeping steam workshop in mind for the future as it greatly benefits any sandbox game.

I think the game devs have a good direction in mind looking at their roadmap, I think it definitely needs more in game clarity and direction to things you can do in game shown to the players. Like what the hell does citizenship do? What are the benefits of owning a apartment?

Give it a year or two, or get it on sale you've heard my two cents. Now shoo!
items.text_zh:
[h2] 核心游戏是扎实的，然而由于优化问题，以及游戏内缺乏适当的引导（我当时在YouTube上看了好几个小时的指南，而那些好的指南少得可怜），而且坦白说，所有角色都丑得要命，真是烦死人了，甚至很难捏出一个好看的角色。拜托，这是一个虚构的现实，你想让人们沉浸其中，对吧？[/h2]

[h3] 优点 [/h3]
[list]
[*] 完全可定制的飞船
[*] - 你可以随意移动驾驶座等东西，不用太担心

[*] 一旦你理解了，建造系统就很扎实

[*] 非常自由的沙盒
[*] - 你可以前往许多地方，进行许多NPC互动

[*] 你能感受到自己的进步
[*] - 从一艘10x10的死亡陷阱扩展到50x50的飞船感觉真的很棒，因为你可以打捞更多东西，并以惊人的速度积累财富

[*] 相当令人上瘾的游戏循环
[*] - 直到你在游戏中稳定了财务状况，然后性能就成了问题

[*] 角色肖像有动画是件好事，因为它们能实时显示角色的状况
[/list]

[h3] 缺点 [/h3]
[*] 相当多的bug，有些甚至与存档文件绑定，所以完全重启也无法修复
[*] - 我曾因为暴露在一些吸烟的人面前而永久咳嗽，在8小时的游戏时间里一直咳，直到角色死亡，我开了新游戏

[*] 随着规模扩大，优化问题相当严重
[*] - 我设法多雇了一名船员，结果就有点卡顿了

[*] 整个工作系统相比打捞显得如此繁琐，我真看不出有什么意义
[*] - 应该有一些更简单的，比如修理空间站周围的东西。因为我想你在经济困难时会想做那些工作

[*] 角色肖像通常看起来非常难看，似乎没有什么好理由，即使是那些可能有钱做整容手术的富人也是如此

[*] 一些技能，比如黑客，似乎除了在角色创建时之外没有简单的获取途径
[*] - 这真的限制了你所能追求的方向，感觉会削弱你的前期游戏

[*] 超级杂乱的UI，不记得窗口位置，所以你每次打开和关闭都得重新排列
[*]  - 如果能吸附到网格或彼此对齐可能会更好

[*] 相当蹩脚的AI，从警察船像死亡球一样撞向你自己的船，到AI船员把自己弄死，以及一件一件地搬东西而不是用推车。
[/list] 

[h2] 结论 [/h2]
如果我们把所有优化问题都去掉，而且你不介意看很多指南。这游戏大概能得6.5/10分，如果不是因为大多数角色都那么难以直视的话。

我能看出，如果你通过角色创建职业获得了一个好的开局，核心前期游戏是很有吸引力的。如果未来能考虑到Steam创意工坊，那肯定会受益匪浅，因为这对任何沙盒游戏都有极大的好处。

我认为游戏开发者根据他们的路线图有一个很好的方向，我认为它绝对需要在游戏内更清晰地向玩家展示可以做的事情和方向。比如，公民身份到底有什么用？拥有一间公寓有什么好处？

给它一两年时间，或者等打折时再买，我的两分钱意见你已经听到了。现在走开！

items.text:
This game is chock full of severe, game-breaking, run-ruining bugs, many of which have been in the game for multiple years with no indication they will be fixed any time soon. The typical playthrough ends when the game is eventually rendered unplayable by steadily accumulating glitches, which happens sooner or later every single time.  It's a testament to how good the underlying idea is that it's still one of the best games I've played in years.

You should buy this game if it looks at all interesting, you're probably going to love it, you just need to understand what you're getting.  This is not a finished product.  It's a rough, work-in-progress development build of an absolute masterpiece.  There is jank absolutely everywhere.  Your game will crash sometimes.  Your saves will be corrupted. Your NPC crew will, if they can ever reach a treadmill, run on that treadmill until they die of exhaustion. The AI will occasionally decide to jump out of airlocks without suits or helmets. Your need bars will routinely duplicate themselves, resulting in infinite exhaustion that can never be cleared no matter how much you sleep.  And when it works, it won't matter, because you'll be having a blast.

如果这款游戏看起来哪怕有一点意思，你就应该买它，你可能会爱上它，你只需要明白自己买的是什么。这不是一个完成品。它是一款绝对杰作的粗糙、开发中的版本。到处都是粗糙感。你的游戏有时会崩溃。你的存档会损坏。你的NPC船员，如果它们能走到跑步机前，就会一直跑到累死为止。AI偶尔会决定不穿宇航服或头盔就从气闸跳出去。你的需求条会经常自我复制，导致无限的疲惫，无论你睡多久都无法清除。而当它正常运作时，这些都无所谓，因为你会玩得非常开心。

items.text:
I added Ostranauts to my library on January 1, 2025. I'm writing this review on January 8, 2025 after having not played it all day. According to Steam, I've logged 87 hours at his point. According to my ingame save (not including failed runs, and time spent reloading due to the few bugs still present in the early access version of this game), I've played for over 50 real hours. I have a job, and a family.

Please send help.

Ostranauts is one of the very, very few games that qualifies for the very best rating I can give. It has 'civved' me in a way that the Civilizations franchise was not able to. I have a logged, notable drop in sleep duration since I started playing. The very fact that I cannot seem to put it down, even when passing in and out of consciousness while playing, speaks for itself.

Pros:
+ The game has a harsh, unforgiving, progression curve, but fair in a way that games like Dark Souls are not.  Unlike other sandbox style games, progression isn't arbitrarily limited to extend gameplay. The game is just difficult enough to extend gameplay naturally, without it feeling manufactured.
+ The game is truly sandbox, with a nod to realism that is hard to find in a futuristic sci-fi setting. You can absolutely start with a ship that lacks life support, and no EVA suit. Nobody will stop you, in fact, the bank actively encourages it. Actions have consequences that are realisitic. Breaking into a locked door only punishes you if you get caught, but it is something you can do. You can also choose to act 'legally' by in-universe rules. There is no railroad.
+ Every iota of progress in the game feels good, and hard earned. The genuine excitement I got from upgrading ship class the first time put me on cloud nine (and annoyed my spouse). The sense of accomplishment from succeeding in this game rivals what I feel at my actual job. Similarly, failing to succeed (or having fun for my B12G DF homies) left me hungry to do better, rather than discouraged.
+ For an early access game, it is remarkably polished. The UI seems fitting with the art style, and not unfinished. While lore and interaction with game elements lacks some polish (particularly with NPC's), the majority of the remaining content feels polished and, if not complete, fleshed out sufficiently to feel full featured.
+ Development is active. Development is also intelligent. This developer is not just pushing content out at breakneck speed, it's quality content that enriches the game in a well thought out manner.

Cons:
- Some game-breaking bugs still exist. This is expected in early access, but does need to be noted. Particularly, you can do nothing wrong and lose a significant chunk of progress. In the current game state, I reccommend save scumming, and frequent saves.
- Some major bugs that are not game breaking still exist. I have had to relaunch the game a couple times to take care of issues where the game state has reached an unexpected spot (such as my character not actually going to sleep, and just awkwardly standing on the bed and doing his best impression of a mannequin instead). In all major bugs I have found, a reload from the main screen has corrected the bug.
- Some game states are not saved by the save function. I would not recommend saving while attached to a wreck, or while en-route to one.
-  Some minor bugs exist that will interrupt gameplay, but not in a way that you can realistically undo. The biggest one that comes to mind is a bug with undocking that teleports the derelict a significant distance away if you release your docking clamps while unpaused. It's rare, but makes revisiting to salvage/flip the wreck effectively impossible.

I may update this review in the future, as I don't think I've explored even a quarter of the content available yet, and development is very active.

我在2025年1月1日将《Ostranauts》添加到了我的库中。我在2025年1月8日写下这篇评测，此前我一整天都没玩它。根据Steam的记录，此时我已经玩了87小时。根据我的游戏内存档（不包括失败的运行，以及因这款游戏早期访问版本中仍存在的少数bug而重新加载所花费的时间），我已经玩了超过50个真实小时。我有工作，还有家庭。

请派人来救救我。

《Ostranauts》是极少数、极少数能获得我能给出的最高评级的游戏之一。它以一种《文明》系列未能做到的方式让我“文明上瘾”了。自从我开始玩以来，我的睡眠时长出现了有记录的、显著的下降。我似乎无法放下它，哪怕在玩的时候意识时断时续，这一事实本身就说明了一切。

优点：
+ 游戏有着严酷、无情的进度曲线，但其公平的方式是《黑暗之魂》这类游戏所不具备的。与其他沙盒风格游戏不同，进度不会被武断地限制以延长游戏时间。游戏只是难到足以自然地延长游戏时间，而不会让人觉得是人为制造的。
+ 游戏是真正的沙盒，并带有一种在未来科幻设定中难以找到的现实主义色彩。你完全可以从一艘没有生命维持系统、也没有EVA宇航服的飞船开始。没人会阻止你，事实上，银行还积极鼓励这么做。行为会产生符合现实的后果。闯入一扇锁着的门只会在你被抓到时惩罚你，但这是你可以做的事。你也可以选择按照游戏世界内的规则“合法”行事。没有强制路线。
+ 游戏中每一点进步都让人感觉良好，而且来之不易。第一次升级飞船等级时，我获得的真切兴奋让我飘飘欲仙（还惹恼了我的配偶）。在这款游戏中取得成功所带来的成就感，堪比我在实际工作中感受到的成就感。同样地，未能成功（或者为了我的B12G DF兄弟们找乐子）让我渴望做得更好，而不是感到气馁。
+ 对于一款早期访问游戏来说，它打磨得异常精良。UI似乎与美术风格相称，并不显得未完成。虽然背景设定以及与游戏元素的互动还缺少一些打磨（尤其是与NPC的互动），但剩余内容的大部分都感觉经过打磨，即使不算完整，也已充实到足以让人觉得功能齐全。
+ 开发很活跃。开发也很明智。这位开发者不只是以极快的速度推出内容，而是以经过深思熟虑的方式丰富游戏的高质量内容。

缺点：
- 仍然存在一些破坏游戏的bug。这在早期访问中是可以预料的，但确实需要指出。尤其是，你可能什么都没做错，却失去相当大一部分进度。在当前游戏状态下，我建议反复读档，并频繁存档。
- 仍然存在一些不会破坏游戏的大bug。我不得不重启游戏几次，以处理游戏状态进入意外位置的问题（例如我的角色实际上没有去睡觉，而是尴尬地站在床上，尽力模仿一个人体模型）。在我发现的所有大bug中，从主界面重新加载都修正了bug。
- 有些游戏状态不会被存档功能保存。我不建议在附着于残骸时，或在前往残骸途中存档。
- 还存在一些会打断游玩的小bug，但其方式并不是你现实中能够撤销的。我想到的最大一个是脱离对接时的bug，如果你在未暂停时释放对接夹，它会把废弃飞船传送到相当远的地方。这很罕见，但会让返回打捞/转卖残骸实际上变得不可能。

我将来可能会更新这篇评测，因为我认为自己连可用内容的三分之一都还没探索到，而且开发非常活跃。

You will lose an hour to several of your play time. It will be frustrating as hell. And it will happen over and over. Sure, patches keep going out. But the game just isn't reliable enough yet. Отыграл почти 30 часов и у меня игра достаточно подогрела меня для написания обзора.

В игре есть составляющие хорошей песочницы, но многие механики реализованы настолько неудобно, что ими не хочется пользоваться. Строительство реализовано на троечку, при чем хуже всего сделана часть с установкой "чертежей" - слишком много кликов нужно сделать чтобы поставить хоть что-то и нет абсолютно никаких "шорткатов". В игре в которой нужно управлять космическим кораблем и его командой практически отсутствуют какие-то кнопки для управление как таковые. Можно с помощью клавиатуры управлять кораблем и персонажем, все остальное выполняется через интерфейс ПДА или самого корабля. Я считаю, что для песочницы это непростительно. 

Еще в плане геймплея чувствуется какая-то пустота. По большому счету помимо разборки (и сборки) кораблей на свалке тут нечем больше занятся. Мне надоело за 30 часов.

Не рекомендую.


Обновление в 2026.

已经玩了将近30个小时，这游戏足够让我有动力写一篇评测了。

游戏里有构成优秀沙盒的元素，但很多机制的实现方式实在太不方便，让人根本不想去用。建造系统做得只能算及格，其中最糟糕的是放置“蓝图”的部分——想放下哪怕一个东西都要点太多次，而且完全没有快捷键。在一个需要管理飞船及其船员的游戏里，几乎没有任何用于操作本身的按键。你可以用键盘控制飞船和角色，其他一切都得通过PDA或飞船本身的界面来完成。我认为对于一款沙盒游戏来说这是不可原谅的。

另外在玩法方面也感觉有些空洞。基本上除了在废料场拆解（和组装）飞船之外，这里就没别的事可做了。30个小时我就玩腻了。

不推荐。


2026年的更新。
玩了几个小时，UI好像大幅修正了。
到达空间站后，在太空里卖战利品时角色自己走了出去，然后窒息而死。没有自动存档。仍然不推荐

items.text:
The bugs are there. 
Good news is i've encountered just a couple in the 20 hours of play and only one was gamebreaking (not able to save due to NPCs quickly eating up gigabytes of drive space on a savefile), but it's a known bug and a workaround is there on the forums.
Bad news is there's not much content at the moment. 
The early game is great. I struggled to make ends meet with a tiny starter ship until i found a broken reactor and went above and beyond to repair and sell it for a 100k. With the money i bought a decent pressurised derelict where i previously killed a pirate and restored it into my new and improved salvage barge that creaks and groans every time i fire up the RCS. The whole process, the journey felt amazing.
But after that there's not much to do unfortunately. By the current midgame you could do a couple of the freelance contracts or keep scavenging but there's little to spend the money on except bigger ships to bring in more salvage, rinse and repeat.
In short the game has great potential and for what it's worth i enjoyed it immensely. But if you're like me and expecting a game to sink hundreds of hours in this is not it yet, but it's getting there.

items.text:
Absolutely great potential for a game and the creator seems to be working diligently on it. I most definitely recommend this game if you're a fan of DF style games.

If you love DF, Rimworld or any of the other top-down games in DF style, Ostranauts is most likely for you. The learning curve is steep like DF, and if you don't pay attention during the tutorial messages (like I did), you'll end up hauling every part by hand, not realising there is zones you can create to save hauling your haul of 14 doors, 2 reactors, 6 tanks one by one, all by hand, enduring a ~5 minute transition period to the blackmarket to pawn your haul per item, only to realise the guy has switched to paying under market rate for your Reactor and you have to wait another 5 minutes to hope he'll offer a reasonable price again. Took me ~25 hours of doing this before I followed the tutorial message on a new save.

Another tip: Most definitely don't decide to ransack the cops ship when they're docked to your ship. Within ~2 minutes of being on his ship (with him trying to fly away still docked), both our ships were looking more holy than a Nang Huffer's brain. The haul of 2 EVA batteries weren't worth the complete rebuild of my ship at the start of the game. Great moments of this game make it completely a steal for the price.

Since it is in early access, expect many, many crashes and bugs. Autosaving seems to be a big issue from my experience, the game runs best with it switched off. Once I've gotten about 16 hours on a save, autosaving (set to every 1 hour) takes ~45 minutes per save with a 1/3 chance of it crashing the game during saving. Especially at the OKLN station with several ships worth of loot on board. The game is definitely getting better with every update.

There was a rather annoying bug where every time my character felt an emotion (like remissness or name drop), it would stay on the ship as a blocked tile. Really bloody annoying but work-around-able. Thank you to the Devs for patching it in the last release.

这款游戏绝对有巨大的潜力，而且创作者似乎正在勤奋地开发它。如果你是DF风格游戏的粉丝，我绝对推荐这款游戏。

如果你喜欢DF、Rimworld或任何其他DF风格的俯视角游戏，Ostranauts很可能适合你。学习曲线像DF一样陡峭，如果你在教程消息期间不注意（就像我一样），你最终会手动搬运每一个部件，没有意识到你可以创建区域来省去一件一件手动搬运你那14扇门、2个反应堆、6个罐子的收获，忍受大约5分钟的过渡时间到黑市去典当你的每件收获，结果却发现那家伙已经改成以低于市场价的价格收购你的反应堆，而你必须再等5分钟，希望他会再次给出合理的价格。我这样做了大约25个小时，才在一个新存档里遵循了教程消息。

另一个提示：绝对不要决定在警察的船停靠在你船上时洗劫它。在他船上大约2分钟内（他还试图在仍然停靠的情况下飞走），我们两艘船看起来都比Nang Huffer的大脑还要圣洁。2块EVA电池的收获不值得在游戏初期对我的船进行彻底重建。这款游戏的精彩时刻让它以这个价格来说完全是白捡的。

由于它处于抢先体验阶段，预计会有很多很多崩溃和bug。根据我的经验，自动保存似乎是个大问题，关闭它游戏运行最好。一旦我在一个存档上玩了大约16个小时，自动保存（设置为每1小时一次）每次保存大约需要45分钟，并且有1/3的几率在保存期间导致游戏崩溃。尤其是在OKLN空间站，船上载着好几艘船价值的战利品时。这款游戏肯定随着每次更新都在变得更好。

有一个相当烦人的bug，每次我的角色感受到一种情绪（比如悔恨或点名），它都会留在船上成为一个被阻挡的格子。真是烦人得要命，但可以绕过。感谢开发者在最后一个版本中修补了它。

I am giving this game a positive review, because I really enjoyed my time with it (for the most part, see below), and if the features that aren't in it yet make it into the final game, it will be epic. 

**HOWEVER**

If you are on the fence at all about buying it now or waiting, I recommend waiting. 

 The actual content that is currently in the game was well worth the price to me. I really enjoyed flying around and salvaging. I found a nice big freighter with barely any damage or anything missing and patched it up. Then I began collecting parts and laying out plans for remodelling the interior to make it exactly how I wanted it. I was really loving this game.

I could overlook it's jankiness, because of the fun I was having otherwise.  Sometimes I would attempt to put objects on the floor of my ship and they'd vanish completely. I lost an entire crate full of equipment to this bug. Sometimes my character would get stuck and I'd have to reload a save, losing an hour of gameplay. A salvaged door wouldn't fit on the floor, so I couldn't put it down, but then it wouldn't go back into my inventory either so every time I opened the inventory I'd have this door in my hand again and couldn't do anything else. Reload a save, lose progress. 

As I said, I could live with all that. Save more often, shrug it off.  However, the early access jank chose a new form just now and it broke my enthusiasm.  I am 18 hours in, and still had my original starting character. Just now I was playing and the game bugged out again. I opened a context menu for a door or something, but it wouldn't let me select anything. Frozen again, no huge deal. I saved and exited to menu. Tried to continue from the save, which has always worked before. Nope. Get an error screen saying program has to restart. Close it, try again. No dice, same message.

There is only one save file, so when it inevitably gets corrupted, that game is done. It's infuriating.

18 hours down the drain. I don't have the patience or the desire to start over from scratch, especially knowing it will just happen again. So I'm going to wait until this game is much further along in development before playing it again. I know it is Early Access and bugs are the norm. I can deal with nuisances, but completely losing my save is where I draw the line.

So, if you think the game looks like fun, you will probably have fun with it. What is there was worth the price, when it worked. If, however, losing all your progress after many hours of play will piss you off (as it did me), then you'd be better off waiting until the game is much further along.


**Update-4/14/20***

I got over the anger at losing my save and started over. Played 10 more hours and enjoyed my time in the game. I'm still going to recommend waiting a bit for bug fixes if you feel like that will aggravate you.  There's also not a ton of content, aside from the basic loop of flying around and salvaging, and fixing up your ship. 10 hours into my new game and I'm rich beyond my ability to spend it. There are a few more things I've yet to try, but not much.

Still, I enjoyed it for 28 hours so far, and do not regret the purchase.

我给这款游戏一个好评，因为我真的很享受玩它的时光（大部分时候是这样，详见下文），而且如果那些尚未加入的功能能进入最终版本，它将会非常史诗。

**然而**

如果你对现在买还是再等等有任何犹豫，我建议再等等。

目前游戏中的实际内容对我来说完全值这个价。我真的很喜欢四处飞行和打捞。我找到了一艘又大又好的货船，几乎没有任何损坏或缺失的东西，然后把它修好了。接着我开始收集零件，并规划内部改造方案，想把它弄成我理想中的样子。我当时真的很喜欢这款游戏。

我可以忽略它的粗糙，因为除此之外我玩得很开心。有时候我会尝试把物品放在飞船的地板上，它们就会完全消失。我因为这个bug损失了整整一箱装备。有时候我的角色会卡住，我不得不重新加载存档，损失一个小时的游戏进度。一扇打捞来的门放不进地板，所以我没法把它放下，但它也回不到我的物品栏里，所以每次我打开物品栏，这扇门就又出现在我手里，我什么别的都做不了。重新加载存档，进度丢失。

就像我说的，这些我都能忍。多存档，耸耸肩就过去了。然而，抢先体验版的粗糙刚刚换了一种新形式，击垮了我的热情。我已经玩了18个小时，用的还是最初创建的角色。刚才我在玩的时候，游戏又出bug了。我打开了一个门或什么东西的上下文菜单，但它不让我选择任何东西。又卡住了，本来不算什么大事。我保存并退出到菜单。尝试从存档继续，这以前一直都能用。不行。出现一个错误屏幕，说程序必须重启。关掉，再试。没用，同样的提示。

只有一个存档文件，所以当它不可避免地损坏时，这个游戏就完了。这让人极其愤怒。

18个小时付诸东流。我没有耐心也没有意愿从头再来，尤其是知道这种事还会再次发生。所以我打算等到这款游戏开发得更加完善之后再玩。我知道这是抢先体验，bug是常态。我可以应付各种烦人的小问题，但完全丢失存档是我的底线。

所以，如果你觉得这游戏看起来好玩，你大概会玩得开心。在它能正常运行的时候，现有的内容值这个价。但是，如果你在玩了很多小时后丢失所有进度会让你火冒三丈（就像我一样），那你最好等到游戏开发得更加完善再说。


**更新-2020年4月14日***

我从丢失存档的愤怒中缓了过来，重新开始。又玩了10个小时，很享受在游戏里的时光。如果你觉得那些问题会让你恼火，我仍然建议再等一段时间，等bug修复。除了四处飞行、打捞和修飞船这个基本循环之外，内容也不算多。新游戏玩了10个小时，我富得钱都花不完。还有几样东西我还没试过，但也不多了。

不过，到目前为止我享受了28个小时，并不后悔购买。

编辑（2024年9月）：最近我玩了很多太空游戏，比如加了模组的《星空》、《星际公民》和《精英危险》，试图满足一种特定的渴望（太空生存沙盒/故事生成器）。我现在没有PC，但我买了一个月的Shadow来在他们的免费飞行活动期间玩《星际公民》。结果最后玩了这个，它让我前所未有地上瘾。真的经历了我最棒的游戏时刻/成就。希望能在这里发出来，但字符限制什么的。这是一款特别的游戏，迫不及待想看看它会如何发展。

A quick preface here: This review is based on the early access release as of 12th October 2020. This game is [b]BROKEN[/b] and needs a fair bit of patience to play. There is only the one save slot and it's easy to overwrite it and wind up with all your effort so far being lost. This is very-very Early-Early Access, bear that in mind.

That said, it's a great game (the huge number of bugs, some game breaking, notwithstanding). The lack of a tutorial makes it hard at first to get your head around it but basically you play a spacer in a huge space junk yard. You start off with a little money and a tiny shuttle, you have to buy the gear you need and fly to, then fix up, a derelict space ship. That's pretty much it at the moment but as you have an extremely complex control system where you have to scavenge parts from a number of hulks before you can fix up the trash ship of your dreams, and everything is included: Floors/Walls to make it airtight, doors to compartmentalise, temp gauges/heaters/coolers to control the temp, O2/N2/air pumps to control the pressure and breathability, beds, fridges, toilets, sinks, food, water, money, power plants, batteries, wiring, lights... believe me, it's enough to be going on with. 

It's pretty complex and you'll probably kill yourself several time learning the ropes (there is not as much as a warning that you're about to do something really stupid when you lift a floor panel while out of an EVA suit and expose yourself to hard vacuum). The game allows you to do so much, but at the same time doesn't hold your hand at all. Definitely worth putting on your wish list if you don't like EA and buggy games, worth a punt if you can put up with all the above.

话虽如此，这仍是一款很棒的游戏（尽管有大量的bug，有些还会破坏游戏进程）。没有教程一开始让人很难理解，但基本上你扮演一个在巨大太空废料场的太空人。你一开始有一点钱和一艘小穿梭机，你必须购买所需的装备，飞到一艘废弃的太空船那里，然后把它修好。目前差不多就是这样，但由于你有一个极其复杂的控制系统，你必须从多艘废船中搜集零件，才能修好你梦想中的垃圾船，而且一切都包含在内：地板/墙壁让它气密，门来分隔舱室，温度计/加热器/冷却器来控制温度，O2/N2/空气泵来控制压力和可呼吸性，床、冰箱、马桶、水槽、食物、水、钱、发电厂、电池、电线、灯……相信我，这些足够你忙一阵子了。

它相当复杂，你可能会在摸索过程中把自己弄死好几次（当你没穿EVA服就掀起一块地板面板，把自己暴露在硬真空中时，连一句警告都没有，告诉你即将做一件非常愚蠢的事）。游戏允许你做很多事情，但同时完全不手把手教你。如果你不喜欢抢先体验和满是bug的游戏，绝对值得加入愿望单；如果你能忍受以上所有问题，值得一试。

[h1] Release/Early Access Review [/h1]

[i] Is the game for everyone? [/i]

Not in the slightest. If you haven’t played Neo Scavenger or just don’t enjoy 2D roguelike games then you’re going to have a bad time. You’ll be frustrated, annoyed, and too put off to enjoy a niche genre. That’s okay. 

[i] Is Early Access for everyone? [/i]

Not at all. In fact, EA can actually lead to some poor development practices from companies. There are a lot of dead games that never made it out of EA in my library to attest to that. But, judging from experience with Neo Scavenger, there will be bugs, there will be feedback, and this game will be made. I followed NS from the website alpha, and bought it again on Steam and enjoyed experiencing the product along with development. It was a long journey, the nature of these games will require multiple starts regardless[spoiler] you will die lol [/spoiler]. But if you want to support the dev and see more games like this it can be a fun ride.

TL;DR Yes, I experienced game breaking bugs. Lost my first save in <1h. No the gender system isn’t a big deal. If you refunded <2h played, didn’t figure out how to fly your salvage pod, dock, replace the battery (basic stuff) etc... sure you’re probably frustrated but if you’re easily frustrated this game isn’t for you. If you want to support the dev and enjoyed doing that in the past go for it, or just wait six months to a year and see where things are then.

items.text:
So this is an update to my initial review, years now after the original Early Access release; below the line at the bottom is my original review. I still think it was a big mistake to put the game in Early Access when they did, however, the current game is an absolutely massive shift from where it was. This game is a major slow burn, with an emphasis more on gradual buildup of your resources and building out/modifying your ship (or trading up outright). Very intricate, very customizable, very granular. Panels. Switches. Lights. Wiring. Pressure. Temperature. All this stuff is important and keeps you from dying of cold, heat, no air, too much air, etc.

This is NOT a fast game. That is not at all a bad thing. It is slower-paced and, if you're into the experience, really sucks you in.  It's pretty amazing how much you can change and add and salvage. You can also fail to remember that you don't have a helmet on, step outside to work on your ship, and promptly die in the vacuum of space. The environment is harsh, the game is harsh, and it's pretty easy to die if you aren't careful. If you ARE careful, you can go quite a long way.

So I would now definitely recommend this game... if you're into this kind of game. It's really great at what it does, but it has a very specific, slow, high complexity, high difficulty flavor. For instance, getting your first fusion engine is huge, but READ THE MANUAL. If you don't read that manual, be prepared for disappointment in trying to assemble the reactor and frustration trying to turn it on. But that's just how this sort of game works.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
A great example of why Steam really needs to apply some basic standards to Early Access games. An Early Access game should, at a minimum, be PLAYABLE. As in, you should be able to play at least a major part of the game without it crashing, bugging out, or corrupting a save so badly as to be unplayable.

As this stands now, I can't provide a review for the game. I've only managed to die a few times, but the game has crashed out, bugged out, and killed my saves several times more than that already. I honestly can't remember the last time I encountered a game so buggy it killed saves regularly, so this is inexcusable. 

It's basically just a big pile of frustration right now because even when you DO manage to keep things going right for long enough to ALMOST achieve something, the game inevitably crashes into a corrupted save and you lose everything. Combined with a single-save autosave system (even though the game is nowhere NEAR stable enough to justify that step yet), this is essentially spending 15-20 bucks on a broken, nonfunctional program where you can't even work around the bugs.

This is not a playable demo, this is not an Early Access game, this is only slightly above the level of a playable alpha or concept demo. This is months away from being playable enough even for Early Release.
items.text_zh:
所以这是对我最初评测的更新，距最初的抢先体验发布已经过去好几年了；底部横线下方是我最初的评测。我仍然认为当初在那个时间点把游戏放进抢先体验是个巨大的错误，不过，现在的游戏与当时相比已经有了绝对巨大的转变。这款游戏是一个典型的慢热型作品，更强调逐步积累资源，以及建造/改造你的飞船（或者直接以旧换新升级）。非常精细，非常可定制，非常细致入微。面板。开关。灯光。布线。压力。温度。所有这些东西都很重要，能让你不至于死于寒冷、高温、没有空气、空气过多等等。

这绝不是一款快节奏游戏。这完全不是坏事。它节奏较慢，如果你喜欢这种体验，它会真的把你吸进去。你能改变、添加和打捞的东西之多，相当惊人。你也可能忘记自己没戴头盔，走到外面去修飞船，然后立刻死在太空的真空中。环境严酷，游戏严酷，如果不小心，很容易死掉。如果你确实小心，你可以走得很远。

所以我现在肯定会推荐这款游戏……前提是你喜欢这类游戏。它非常擅长它所做的事情，但它有一种非常特定、缓慢、高复杂度、高难度的风味。比如，得到你的第一台聚变引擎是件大事，但要读手册。如果你不读那本手册，那就准备好在你尝试组装反应堆时失望，在尝试启动它时受挫吧。但这类游戏就是这样运作的。

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
这是一个很好的例子，说明为什么Steam真的需要对抢先体验游戏应用一些基本标准。一款抢先体验游戏至少应该是可玩的。也就是说，你应该能够玩到游戏的至少一大部分，而不会崩溃、出bug，或者把存档损坏到无法游玩的地步。

就目前的情况而言，我无法为这款游戏提供评测。我只设法死了几次，但游戏崩溃、出bug、毁掉我存档的次数已经比那多好几倍了。老实说，我不记得上一次遇到一款如此充满bug、以至于经常毁掉存档的游戏是什么时候了，所以这是不可原谅的。

现在它基本上就是一大堆挫败感，因为即使你确实设法让事情顺利运行得足够久，几乎要达成某个目标，游戏也总会崩溃成损坏的存档，然后你失去一切。再加上单一存档自动保存系统（尽管游戏还远没有稳定到足以证明这一步是合理的），这基本上就是花15到20美元买一个损坏的、无法运行的程序，而且你甚至无法绕过这些bug。

这不是可玩的演示版，这不是抢先体验游戏，这只比可玩的alpha版或概念演示版高一点点。它距离即使作为抢先发布也足够可玩，还有好几个月。
